This directory contains the repository's validation and maintenance scripts.

## Main scripts

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [check.py](check.py) | Verifies each module's CSV, SQL, JSON Schema and Notion outputs agree |
| [validate.py](validate.py) | Checks directory structure, required sections and prompt blocks |
| [check_indexes.py](check_indexes.py) | Validates catalog and index consistency |
| [seo.py](seo.py) | Rebuilds generated SEO blocks and discovery files |
| [skillmd.py](skillmd.py) | Parses `SKILL.md` files from code |

## Common commands

```bash
python3 tools/check.py all
python3 tools/validate.py
python3 tools/seo.py --check
python3 tools/seo.py
```

## Why these exist

The project depends on a shared contract across all skills. These tools ensure the generated output, structure and metadata stay aligned and do not drift over time.
